name: xmlens
description: Browser-only, MIT-licensed XML development and visualization tool.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/workers/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p spikes/r1-uri/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e:spike: vite build --config spikes/codemirror/vite.config.ts && playwright test --config spikes/codemirror/playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run i18n:check && npm run plugins:guard && npm run license:check && npm run notices:check && npm run changelog:check
